160246: Karyl can be described as a 'Tsundere' as she is often complaining about her friend, but always follows along regardless. She has a sharp tongue and often gets annoyed and/or flustered. She tries to act tough and harsh on the outside but in fact she is quite soft-hearted.
160247: Possessing a voracious appetite and boundless energy, Pecorine lives a seemingly carefree life from meal to meal. She is ever optimistic and is proactive in making friends, regardless of their attitude in return.
160248: A member of the guild Gourmet Edifice.
160249: An amnesiac with good intentions but often clueless.
167275: Eriko is an obsessive girl who is infatuated with Yuuki, often going to large lengths to gain his affection. She is shown to be drastic and manipulative, akin to that of a Yandere. With few exceptions, she is often dismissive of the people around her.
169506: Aoi is a very shy girl who has trouble making friends, though she has the determination to try and 'overcome trials/hurdles'. One day she meets Yuuki and together they form the 'BB Brigade' in order to make new friends.
169507: Hatsune is a girl with super powers that include telekinesis and teleportation. She chooses to hide these powers in the real world. However, whenever she tries to use these powers, she gets sleepy due to recoil and often falls asleep (sometimes in random places).
169700: Shiori is a calm and reserved girl. She has a condition that leaves her rather sickly and staying at The Farm helps her condition with its outdoor atmosphere.
173753: Miyako has an endless appetite for pudding and often makes it her top priority. She gets extremely angry when pudding gets taken away from her or if someone else eats her pudding.
192579: Charlie's older brother. In his later appearance, he grows out his goatee to connect with his afro.
